Name: Eshtemoa, Son of Hodiah
Summary: Named as Eshtemoa the Maachathite in Judah's genealogy.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:19: Named as Eshtemoa the Maachathite in Judah's genealogy.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Eshtemoa stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
